download_checksum_for_capture: download the CHECKSUM file for a given ReInterHand capture ID using wget
download_frame_list_for_capture: download frame_list.txt and frame_list_orig.txt for a given ReInterHand capture ID
run_download_all_captures: run the script to download checksums and frame lists for all capture IDs in the list
create_capture_directories: create directories for each capture ID before downloading files using os.makedirs
review_capture_id_list: review the list of ReInterHand capture IDs used for downloading dataset files
